citation: Raymond, J. Scott. 1981. “The Maritime Foundations of Andean Civilization: A Reconsideration of the Evidence.” American Antiquity 46 (4): 806–821. DOI 10.2307/280107.
notes: Peer-reviewed critique of Moseley’s maritime-foundations thesis. Argues caloric yields from marine remains may be overstated, agricultural potential underestimated, preservation biases underplayed, and late Preceramic site distribution consistent with floodplain agriculture. Tier S. Use in Notes / External contacts / Economy as contested scholarly debate — not as a verdict.
